name: yahoo-search-s-and-p-500
note: Hand-made, not recorded (Yahoo answers only yahoo-finance2's own User-Agent, and none was recorded here): Yahoo's v1 search answer in the shape yahoo-finance2 4.0.6's search schema validates (SearchResult with SearchQuoteYahoo rows: symbol, exchange, exchDisp, shortname, longname, quoteType, typeDisp, index, score, isYahooFinance), asked as the instrument search asks (quotesCount 100, newsCount 0), for "S&P 500": the index (^GSPC), two ETFs on it (SPY, VOO) and the E-mini S&P 500 front month (ES=F). The rows carry Yahoo's symbols, exchange codes and quote types for these instruments; the names follow Yahoo's, the scores are invented.
